text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
We're here at Hanshin Racecourse! Who
do you
think will come out on top
today?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I'm thinking Ikuno Dictus! Win it this
time, Ikuno!
You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I think it'll be Mejiro Palmer. She was
fantastic in
last year's Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
I'm feeling Nishino Flower. This might
not be her
best distance, but she
definitely has the potential
to win it!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
No way! Today's all about Mejiro
McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
There are certainly a lot of people here
today
rooting for Mejiro McQueen! And
how about
you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The person on the other side of the
microphone is
none other than...

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I'm rooting for Matikanetannhauser, of
course!

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Reporter
text_block_list.text:
She's always optimistic and inspiring!
Even
today... I came here just to watch
her!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I can truly feel how rapidly you've
improved since
the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I've marked you as the person I have to
be most
careful of today, and I'll be
doing my absolute
best to beat you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: So, let's have a good race.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Yes, I'll do my best too! I'm looking
forward
to a great race today!
